description: Defines interfaces and classes for NGAP protocol handling within a 3GPP network, including message handling, event notification, connection management, UE context management, and metrics collection.

classes.name: ngap_message_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling incoming NGAP messages.

classes.name: ngap_event_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling NGAP events such as connection loss.

classes.name: ngap_message_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying about new NGAP messages transmitted.

classes.name: ngap_connection_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing NGAP connection procedures like setup, reset, and disconnection.

classes.name: ngap_rrc_ue_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RRC UE events, including new PDUs and radio access info.

classes.name: ngap_cu_cp_ue_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for CU-CP related UE events, security, handover, and context management.

classes.name: ngap_cu_cp_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for CU-CP NGAP events, including UE registration, handover, and transport.

classes.name: ngap_ue_radio_capability_management_handler
classes.description: Handles UE radio capability management messages.

classes.name: ngap_control_message_handler
classes.description: Handles control messages like UE context release and handover procedures.

classes.name: ngap_ue_id_translator
classes.description: Maps between UE IDs and internal indices.

classes.name: ngap_interface
classes.description: Aggregates all NGAP handling interfaces into a single entry point.
